narrative.headline: Find and book WeWork day-desks from the terminal — cities, buildings, availability, price, and your bookings — with a local store for instant, agent-native queries.
narrative.value_prop: WeWork's desk booking is a map-and-modal web app with no CLI and no public API. This CLI reverse-engineers the members-portal read API into scriptable commands: resolve any city, search bookable desks by city + date with credits/price/seat availability, browse buildings and amenities, and list your bookings. Cities and locations sync into a local SQLite store so repeat queries are instant and work offline.
narrative.auth_narrative: WeWork uses a short-lived auth0 Bearer token plus weworkuuid and weworkmembertype headers from a logged-in browser session. Two ways to authenticate: (1) 'wework-pp-cli auth login --chrome' reads the token straight from your Chrome/Brave/Edge profile — quick, but Chrome buffers the live token in memory and flushes to disk lazily, so the on-disk copy can be stale; (2) 'wework-pp-cli auth import' with the DevTools JSON snippet reliably captures a live token. The account uuid + member type are not stored in Chrome — set them once with 'auth import --uuid ... --member-type ...' and they persist (auth login then only refreshes the token). Check with 'wework-pp-cli auth whoami'; re-authenticate when the token goes stale.

quickstart.comment: Health check — confirms the binary and config load (no auth needed). Set up auth first with: wework-pp-cli auth login --chrome (or auth import; see 'auth import --help')
Search bookable desks in a city on a date

troubleshoots.fix: Your auth0 token expired (check 'wework-pp-cli auth whoami'). Re-authenticate: 'wework-pp-cli auth login --chrome' (quick; may be stale if Chrome hasn't flushed) or 'wework-pp-cli auth import' with the live DevTools snippet (reliable).

troubleshoots.symptom: desks returns nothing for a valid city
troubleshoots.fix: Run 'wework-pp-cli sync' first so the city geo is cached, then retry — the search bounding box is derived from cached city coordinates.

troubleshoots.symptom: book fails or returns an unexpected shape
troubleshoots.fix: The book/cancel endpoints are inferred from discovery, not verified. Run with --dry-run to inspect the request, then verify against your account before using --confirm.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to script or agent-drive WeWork day-desk discovery: check whether a desk is available in a given city on a given date, compare prices/credits across buildings, resolve city and building UUIDs, and review your upcoming bookings — all without the web map UI.
